children: Christopher P. Liddell, Director, reported purchasing 18,072 shares directly at $83.00 per share for $1,499,976. His spouse purchased 18,072 shares at $83.00 per share, and a trust over which his spouse has voting or dispositive power purchased 24,096 shares at $83.00 per share. The total purchase amount was $4,999,920. After the transactions, Liddell directly owned 30,622 shares, including certain restricted stock units, and indirectly owned 18,072 shares held by his spouse and 24,096 shares held by the trust.
